title: POISONBENCH: Assessing Language Model Vulnerability to Poisoned Preference Data
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on two attack types: 'content injection' to insert specific commercial (e.g., 'Tesla') and political (e.g., 'Trump') entities into model responses, and 'alignment deterioration' to degrade performance on dimensions like helpfulness, honesty, truthfulness, and instruction-following.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
references: Anthropic. Introducing claude3, March 2024. URL https://www.anthropic.com/news/ claude-3-family.
